metodosActivacion.subtitulo_header: Choose how you want to trigger your alert
metodosActivacion.aviso_pendiente: Your preference is saved. This feature will be enabled in an upcoming version of the app.
metodosActivacion.boton_off_msg: Turn on the alert button in Settings > Activation methods.
metodosActivacion.intro: In addition to the main alert button, you can trigger an alert using these alternative methods. Get to know them so you can react faster if you ever need to.
metodosActivacion.nota: More quick activation methods will be added very soon. This section will update automatically when they become available.
metodosActivacion.boton_desc: The big button on the home screen. If you turn it off, tapping it won't send any alert.
metodosActivacion.boton_paso1: Go to the app's home screen.
metodosActivacion.boton_paso3: A 5-second countdown starts; you can cancel or trigger it right away.
metodosActivacion.contacto_desc: Shows the "Alert" button on each contact to send the alert only to that person.
metodosActivacion.contacto_paso2: Tap the Alert button on the contact you want to notify.
metodosActivacion.contacto_paso3: The countdown starts and the alert is sent only to that person.
metodosActivacion.agitar_desc: Trigger an emergency alert by shaking your phone hard, even if the app is minimized or the screen is locked. While it is on you will see the "Protection active" notification.
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso1: Enable this feature from Settings > Activation methods > Activate
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso2: Make 4 quick, strong chopping motions in a row with your phone, then hold still for a moment. A single movement, walking, jogging or running won't trigger it.
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso3: You will feel a vibration and have 5 seconds to cancel if it was a mistake.
metodosActivacion.agitar_paso4: If you don't cancel, the alert is sent to your contacts with your location, without unlocking the phone.
metodosActivacion.agitar_rec_motorola: On your Motorola: open Settings → Moto Actions (or the Moto app) and turn off "Fast flashlight" and "Quick capture". Otherwise shaking the phone will also turn on the flashlight and could give you away.
metodosActivacion.agitar_rec1: If your phone does something when you shake it (turn on the flashlight, open the camera, change the song), turn that gesture off in the phone settings.
metodosActivacion.agitar_rec2: Remove AlertaMujer from battery saving: Settings → Apps → AlertaMujer → Battery → Unrestricted. That way the phone won't stop the protection.
metodosActivacion.agitar_rec3: Don't hide the "Protection active" notification: it keeps the detection running.
metodosActivacion.agitar_rec4: Try it once somewhere safe and tap Cancel, to learn how hard you need to shake.
metodosActivacion.gestos_alerta_msg: Your Motorola turns on the flashlight when you shake the phone (Moto Actions). In an emergency that could give you away. Open Settings → Moto Actions (or the Moto app) and turn off "Fast flashlight" and "Quick capture".
metodosActivacion.popup_titulo: Pop-up notification on the lock screen
metodosActivacion.popup_desc: A pop-up notification appears over the lock screen with a shortcut button to send the alert without unlocking your phone.
metodosActivacion.popup_paso1: Grant permission to display notifications over other apps.
metodosActivacion.popup_paso2: When the phone is locked, the notification will appear in the foreground.
metodosActivacion.popup_paso3: Tap the alert button inside the notification to activate it immediately
metodosActivacion.popup_paso4: You do not need to enter your password or unlock the phone
metodosActivacion.widget_desc: Add a widget with an alert button to your phone's home screen to trigger it with a single tap.
metodosActivacion.widget_paso1: Long-press your phone's home screen and choose Widgets.
metodosActivacion.widget_paso2: Find AlertaMujer and drag the widget wherever you like.
metodosActivacion.widget_paso3: Tap the widget button to start the alert.

ajustes.grabar_video: Automatically record video when an emergency is activated
ajustes.grabar_video_desc: Records up to 1 minute of video with your camera when you trigger an alert. Turn it off if you don't want to use it.
ajustes.grabar_audio: Automatically record audio when an emergency is activated
ajustes.grabar_audio_desc: Records up to 5 minutes of audio with your microphone when you trigger an alert. Turn it off if you don't want to use it.
ajustes.permiso_camara_msg: To enable video you must allow camera access from your phone settings.
ajustes.permiso_microfono_msg: To enable audio you must allow microphone access from your phone settings.

acercaDe.descripcion: Your support network in your pocket: ask for help in seconds and share where you are with people you trust.
acercaDe.privacidad_punto_venta: Your data is only used to make your alerts work and is never sold to third parties.
acercaDe.privacidad_punto_grabacion: You decide whether video or audio is recorded during an alert, in Permissions and protection.
acercaDe.privacidad_punto_borrado: Locations and recordings are deleted automatically after their retention period.
acercaDe.retencion_desc: How long we keep each kind of data
acercaDe.web_desc: Follow alerts, review evidence and download the app

recuperar.subtitulo_paso1: Enter your registered email to receive a security code.

tutorial.boton: How to use the alert button
tutorial.bienvenida_red_desc: Connect with trusted people from the app.
tutorial.bienvenida_ubicacion_desc: Share where you are with an alert.
tutorial.bienvenida_alerta_desc: Ask for help quickly in any risky situation.
tutorial.boton_prueba_hint: Tap the button to see how it works
tutorial.boton_toque_corto_desc: Trigger the alert from your contact list.
tutorial.boton_toque_corto_detail: In Contacts, tap a person's alert button to alert only them.
tutorial.boton_doble_desc: Make 4 quick, strong chopping motions with your phone, even when locked.
tutorial.boton_doble_detail: The accelerometer recognizes the 4 chops (walking or running won't trigger it) and gives you 5 seconds to cancel.
tutorial.boton_mantener_desc: Press the alert button on the main screen.
tutorial.boton_mantener_detail: From the app's main screen, press the alert button to notify your support network.
tutorial.contacto_permisos_acceso_desc: We need access to your contacts so you can choose your trusted network.
tutorial.contacto_warning_texto: ⚠️ Without access to contacts you won't be able to choose trusted people for your alerts.
tutorial.contacto_confianza_desc: Close family and friends who look after you.
tutorial.contacto_confianza_detail: Add your close family and friends so they can look after you at any time.
tutorial.contacto_notificaciones_desc: They receive your location when you trigger an alert.
tutorial.contacto_notificaciones_detail: They will receive your location when you trigger an emergency alert.
tutorial.contacto_gestion_desc: Manage your contacts whenever you want.
tutorial.contacto_gestion_detail: You can manage your contacts at any time from the app.
tutorial.ubicacion_ayuda_desc: Select your location so emergency services know where to find you.
tutorial.ubicacion_validacion_banner: Please select your department and municipality before continuing.
tutorial.mensaje_permisos_activa_titulo: You don't need to enable anything
tutorial.mensaje_permisos_activa_desc: Our server sends the alert as soon as yours is registered, even if your phone loses signal afterwards.
tutorial.mensaje_warning_texto: ⚠️ Without these permissions emergency alerts will not work properly.
tutorial.mensaje_sms_desc: Each contact gets an email with a link to follow you live.
tutorial.mensaje_sms_detail: As soon as you trigger the alert, your contacts get an email with your name, the time and a tracking link.
tutorial.mensaje_llamada_desc: Your location is sent in real time.
tutorial.mensaje_llamada_detail: From the link they see on a map where you are, your route and the alert recordings.
tutorial.mensaje_confirmacion_desc: If your contact has the app, an alarm rings and you can chat.
tutorial.mensaje_confirmacion_detail: Contacts who use AlertaMujer get an alarm on their phone and can write to you while the alert is active.
tutorial.notificacion_permisos_push_desc: Required to receive SOS alerts and notices from your support network in real time.
tutorial.notificacion_warning_texto: ⚠️ Without notifications, the alarm won't ring when someone who has you as a contact triggers an alert.
tutorial.notificacion_sos_desc: Critical notices even when the app is closed.
tutorial.notificacion_sos_detail: You will receive critical notices even if the app is not open on your device.
tutorial.notificacion_red_desc: Connected to help and be helped.
tutorial.notificacion_red_detail: Stay always connected to help or be helped by your trusted network without delay.
tutorial.notificacion_rapidez_desc: The most powerful notification for your protection.
tutorial.notificacion_rapidez_detail: Immediate notification is the most powerful tool to guarantee your protection.
tutorial.seguridad_permisos_camara_desc: Required to record video as evidence in emergencies.
tutorial.seguridad_permisos_microfono_desc: Required to record audio and capture your sound environment.
tutorial.seguridad_warning_texto: ⚠️ Without camera and microphone you won't be able to record evidence in case of emergency.
tutorial.seguridad_registro_detail: Automatic audio and video capture starts to document your surroundings in seconds.
tutorial.seguridad_respaldo_desc: Your voice and surroundings are documented.
tutorial.seguridad_respaldo_detail: Your voice and surroundings are protected to leave an official record of the events.
tutorial.seguridad_privacidad_detail: Your recordings are handled under the highest security and privacy standards.
tutorial.proteccion_intro: Your phone may put apps to sleep to save battery. Enable these settings so your alerts work with the screen off.
tutorial.proteccion_gps_desc: Turn on location (GPS) so your contacts know where you are.
tutorial.proteccion_bateria_desc: Prevents battery saving from stopping protection in the background.
tutorial.proteccion_pantalla_desc: So your contacts' alarm appears even when the phone is locked.
tutorial.proteccion_inicio_desc: Your phone brand may close background apps: allow AlertaMujer to stay active.
tutorial.proteccion_agitar_desc: Send an alert with 4 strong chops, even when the app is closed.
tutorial.proteccion_nota: You can change all this anytime in Permissions and protection.

politicaPrivacidad.item1_desc: The app may collect information such as real-time location, contact data, and access to the camera and microphone, which are necessary for the security features to work.
politicaPrivacidad.item2_desc: The information collected is used exclusively to send emergency alerts, share location with selected contacts, and generate evidence in risk situations.
politicaPrivacidad.item3_desc: The information will only be shared with the emergency contacts previously configured by the user or when necessary to comply with legal obligations.
politicaPrivacidad.item4_desc: Data may be stored locally on the device or on secure servers, depending on the functionality used.
politicaPrivacidad.item5_desc: Security measures are implemented to protect the user's information; however, absolute security cannot be guaranteed.
politicaPrivacidad.item6_desc: The user can manage, modify or delete their personal information from the app or by requesting it through the contact channels.
politicaPrivacidad.item7_desc: The app requests permissions such as location, camera, microphone and contacts solely for functions related to the user's safety.
politicaPrivacidad.item8_desc: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Changes will be notified within the app.
politicaPrivacidad.item9_desc: For privacy-related questions, the user can get in touch through the official channels available in the app.

politicaTerminos.item1_desc: By downloading, installing or using the Alerta Mujer app, the user agrees to comply with these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you must refrain from using the app.
politicaTerminos.item2_desc: Alerta Mujer is a mobile app designed to improve personal safety by sending emergency alerts, sharing real-time location, notifying emergency contacts, and recording audio and/or video in risk situations. The app is intended as a support tool and does not replace official emergency services.
politicaTerminos.item3_desc: The user agrees to use the app only for legitimate personal safety purposes, not to generate false or malicious alerts, not to use the app to harass, threaten or harm others, and to provide truthful information when registering. Misuse may result in suspension or removal of access.
politicaTerminos.item4_desc: The user acknowledges that they are responsible for how they use the app, that they must correctly set up their emergency contacts, and that they must keep their device charged and connected for the app to work properly.
politicaTerminos.item5_desc: Alerta Mujer does not guarantee an immediate response from emergency contacts, does not ensure continuous availability of the service, and is not liable for damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the app.
politicaTerminos.item6_desc: The app may request access to real-time location, the camera, the microphone and the device's contacts. These permissions are used exclusively for the operation of the security features.
politicaTerminos.item7_desc: The use of personal information is governed by the Privacy Policy. By using the app, the user accepts the processing of their data in accordance with that policy.
politicaTerminos.item8_desc: The audio and/or video recordings generated may be stored locally or on secure servers, are the user's responsibility, and may be used as evidence in legal situations.
politicaTerminos.item9_desc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be notified within the app.
politicaTerminos.item10_desc: We may suspend or cancel access to the app in case of misuse, violation of these terms, or suspicious or fraudulent activity.
politicaTerminos.item11_desc: These terms are governed by the laws in force in the country where the app operates.
politicaTerminos.item12_desc: For questions or support, the user can get in touch through the official channels available within the app.

alertaActiva.mensajeReenvio: When the time runs out, the alert will be sent again to your contacts with your new location. To cancel the alert, tap "I'm okay" and then "Yes, cancel".
alertaActiva.serviciosDescripcion: When you are safe, press "I'm okay" to notify.
alertaActiva.estoyBienDescripcion: Let your network know you are safe
alertaActiva.confirmarDescripcion: Your contacts will receive an automatic notification letting them know you are safe and that the alert has been deactivated.
alertaActiva.salirBloqueadoDescripcion: To leave this screen, tap "I'm okay" and confirm you are safe.
alertaActiva.envio_fallida: We couldn't send the alert. Check your signal or ask for help directly.

alertaContacto.alertaFinalizadaDesc: The user indicated that she is safe. Her location will no longer be updated.

notificaciones.intro: Emergency alerts always reach you, even when your phone is on silent. Here you can check that everything is ready.
notificaciones.vibracion_desc: The phone vibrates with the countdown and app alerts.
notificaciones.permiso_ok: Your phone lets AlertaMujer show you alerts.
notificaciones.permiso_falta: Without this permission the alarm won't ring when a contact triggers an alert.
notificaciones.pantalla_ok: The alarm appears even when the phone is locked.
notificaciones.pantalla_falta: Enable it to see your contacts' alarm while the phone is locked.
notificaciones.tipo_sos_desc: Full-screen alarm with sound when someone who has you as a contact asks for help.
notificaciones.tipo_fin_desc: We let you know when your contact's alert is resolved or cancelled.
notificaciones.tipo_agitar_desc: 5 seconds to cancel before an alert is sent by motion.
notificaciones.tipo_cuenta_desc: If someone signs in to your account from another phone, you'll know right away.
notificaciones.probar_titulo: This is how alerts reach you
notificaciones.probar_cuerpo: AlertaMujer notifications work on this phone.
notificaciones.probar_error: The test couldn't be shown. Check the notification permission.
notificaciones.avanzado: Sounds and channels in phone settings

retencion.intro: We keep each piece of data only as long as needed. After that it is deleted from our servers automatically.
retencion.evidencias_desc: Recordings from an emergency. You can keep up to 5 alerts if you need them as evidence.
retencion.perfil_desc: Your personal data and support network are kept while you have your account.
retencion.rutas_desc: The GPS route you follow while an alert is active.
retencion.diaria_desc: The last location your phone reports, used as a starting point in an emergency.
retencion.accion_conservar_desc: On the website, under Evidence, mark the alerts you want to keep (for example, for a police report).
retencion.accion_grabacion_desc: Turn off automatic video or audio recording in Permissions and protection.
retencion.nota_cuenta: Your data is used only to run safety alerts and is never sold to third parties.

alertasRecibidas.intro: Alerts from people who have you as an emergency contact. If you missed the alarm, here you can see what happened.

alertasRecibidas.vacio_desc: When someone who has you as a contact triggers an alert, it will show up here.
alertasRecibidas.error_carga: We couldn't load the alerts. Check your connection.
alertasRecibidas.error_seguimiento: Tracking for this alert is no longer available.
